name: Install FLauncher (clean, ad-free home screen)
summary: Sideloads FLauncher, an open-source (GPLv3) Android TV launcher with no ads or sponsored rows. You supply the APK you downloaded from its official releases; reclaim just installs it.
notes: reclaim does NOT bundle or download the APK. Point it at an APK you got from FLauncher's official GitHub releases.
Set the path with: reclaim run androidtv/flauncher --apk /path/to/flauncher.apk
To revert, just open Settings and pick the original launcher again.

steps.label: You will be asked for the FLauncher APK path (official releases only).
